titles.name: Shibuya & Shinjuku
titles.figures: 90,304 buildings · 5.4 × 6.2 km · 86% of heights surveyed by PLATEAU

titles.head: The 男坂
titles.text: Fifty-two stone steps between red handrails: the stairs at the end of Your Name, ten years old this year.

titles.head: The scramble
titles.text: Every light turns green at once, the diagonals too: up to 3,000 people a crossing at the evening peak.

titles.head: SHIBUYA SKY
titles.text: Shibuya Scramble Square's open roof, 229 m above the crossing: the highest open-air deck in Japan.

titles.head: Kabukicho Ichibangai
titles.text: The red arch has lit the way in since 1969, to a kabuki theatre that was never built.
